about: Version-preferred mine designs: each preset is a list of template steps (MineTemplates.cs / mineTemplates.ts) on the 64x64 plot, in absolute world y. A design made from one is saved with 'preferred_for <version>'. top 'surface' = the highest ground over the shaft's square on the session's terrain.

presets.name: 1.12.2 diamond strip mine at y 11
presets.notes: A 4x4 spiral shaft from the surface to a landing at y 11, then a 2x3 main corridor east with 1x2 branches 3 blocks apart on both sides. y 11 is the lowest level above the lava lakes (y 10 and below) and inside the diamond, redstone and gold bands; 3 solid blocks between branches show every ore within 1 block of a wall (1.12.2 diamond veins are up to 8 blocks).

presets.name: 1.12.2 lapis and iron strip mine at y 16
presets.notes: Lapis is most common at y 16 and iron is spread evenly below y 64: a 3x3 spiral (1x1 core) down to y 16, then 1x2 branches 3 apart.

presets.name: b1.8.1 diamond strip mine at y 11
presets.notes: Beta 1.8.1's ore veins are one block smaller (diamond up to 7), so the branches are 2 blocks apart: every ore touching a wall is seen. y 11 is above the lava lakes and inside the diamond, redstone and gold bands.

presets.name: b1.8.1 lapis and gold strip mine at y 16
presets.notes: Lapis peaks at y 16 and gold sits below y 32: a 3x3 spiral (1x1 core) down to y 16, then 1x2 branches 2 apart.
